notes: Incident 7, probe half. The canary probe launched in a fresh never-trusted temp directory and the CLI blocked on the first-run folder-trust dialog, then exited rc=1 about two seconds after launch. The captured tail is the interactive dialog; the agent never ran and no probe verdict was ever logged. A probe that could not run is a probe-infrastructure failure: nothing is benched, the verdict stays unknown, and ordinary ledger accounting only.
